chart.title: Add work items to the cycle to view the burndown chart.

priority_issue.title: Observe high priority work items tackled in the cycle at a glance.

assignee.title: Add assignees to work items to see a breakdown of work by assignees.

cycle.label: {count, plural, one {Cycle} other {Cycles}}

start.title: Start cycle
start.question: Start “{name}”? This sets {date} as the start date and moves the cycle to active.

end.title: Complete cycle
end.question: Complete “{name}”? This sets {date} as the end date and marks the cycle complete.

move_unstarted.label: Move unstarted work items to In Progress
move_unstarted.hint: Every backlog and unstarted work item in this cycle moves to the In Progress state.

no_in_progress.title: This project has no In Progress state.
no_in_progress.hint: Work items in this cycle keep the state they already have.

mark_completed.label: Mark every unfinished work item as Completed
mark_completed.hint: {count, plural, one {The # unfinished work item in this cycle moves to the Completed state.} other {All # unfinished work items in this cycle move to the Completed state.}}

no_completed.title: {count, plural, one {# work item is not done yet.} other {# work items are not done yet.}}
no_completed.hint: This project has no Completed state to move them to.

toast.started_moved: “{name}” is active. Unstarted work items moved to In Progress.
toast.completed_moved: “{name}” is complete. Unfinished work items moved to Completed.

toast.dates_taken: Another cycle already covers those dates. Clear the dates to create a draft cycle instead.

transfer.notice: Completed cycles stay editable until they are archived. Unfinished work items can be moved to another cycle.

cycle.drop_archived_error: A work item cannot be moved into an archived cycle
